question: Who holds the position of President of the International Criminal Court (as of April 2025)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Judge Tomoko Akane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Judge Tomoko Akane** is a distinguished **Japanese legal expert** who has held various judicial and prosecutorial positions throughout her career.
 
• She was elected as the President of the International Criminal Court (ICC) for the term starting in 2024 and continuing through 2027, according to the latest information.
 
• Judge Akane has been a member of the ICC since 2018, contributing to international justice and global accountability systems.
 
• Her appointment as President reflects her extensive expertise in criminal law, international law, and judicial administration.
 
• The ICC, based in The Hague, Netherlands, is an independent judicial institution responsible for prosecuting individuals for crimes such as genocide, crimes against humanity, and war crimes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Criminal Court (ICC):**

 
 
• The ICC was established by the Rome Statute, which came into force on** 1 July 2002**.
 
• It is the first permanent international court set up to prosecute individuals for the most serious offenses of concern to the international community.
 
• The ICC operates independently from the United Nations, although they cooperate on various issues.
 
 
 
• **Rome Statute:**
 
 
• This treaty serves as the foundation of the ICC and outlines its jurisdiction, structure, and functioning.
 
• As of 2023, 123 countries are State Parties to the Rome Statute.
 
• Key crimes under the ICC’s jurisdiction include genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes, and the crime of aggression.
 
 
 
• **Judicial Structure of the ICC:**
 
 
• The ICC is composed of 18 judges, elected by the Assembly of States Parties for nine-year terms.
 
• Judges are divided among Pre-Trial, Trial, and Appeals Chambers to ensure fair and efficient proceedings.
 
• The President, along with two Vice-Presidents, is elected from among the judges for a three-year term.
 
 
 
• **Role of the ICC President:**
 
 
• The President oversees the overall administration of the ICC, ensuring its effective functioning.
 
• They represent the Court in external relations and play a crucial role in managing its judicial and administrative activities.
